author: romanLobko
quote: Terrible performance on the base PS5. The story unfolds very slowly. Input lag on the controller. This is definitely not a 99 out of 100. It’s an unplayable port for underpowered consoles, designed to make more money by selling the game a second time on next-gen consoles. Bravo, Rockstar—you’ve really taken the mickey.

author: romanLobko
quote: A wonderful game. An incredibly heartwarming fairy tale that takes you back to childhood, when the world seemed much kinder than it actually was.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
